name: Bubbles
bio: Bubbles was found as a stray near Al Quoz in early 2026 and has blossomed in foster care. She is gentle, house trained, and adores a sofa. She would suit a calm home and is happiest with company.

name: Rocky
bio: Rocky is a cheerful young boy who came to us from a construction site. He is boisterous, loves other dogs, and needs an active home that can keep up with him.
health_notes: Needs a follow-up vaccination in September
